# Shared copper context and cached pair classification

Task06669f3. G0 is the diagnostic legacy preparation; G1 is shared-context
preparation/coarse classification; G2 consumes exactly G1 supports with cached
individual admission. No full ROI solve or public PCB extraction is admitted.

The native harness is `native/analyze/examples/copper_context.rs`. The optimized
geometry measurement imports the actual input/model/geometry and kernel source
modules into one rustc `-O` wrapper using cached crates. Exact generated source,
command, dependency/source/binary hashes and logs are saved in ignored
`debugging/p7-design-checkpoint/copper-context/optimized-*`. The standalone
kernel wrapper is reproducibly generated by `build.py kernel`; it changes no
physical arithmetic. Both existing outputs refuse automatic overwrite/replay.

`preflight-original.json` preserves the first configuration hash. The revised
`preflight.json` adds nearest-support selection when an old microscopic support
disappears within the reported Boolean bound; it was fixed before constructing
the mesh or observing new numerical results. Gates, seeds, orders and budgets
were unchanged. `mesh.py` reuses the existing frozen angular/finite-extrusion
hypothesis and consumes native shared-context ROI union/clip output. Its GEOS
precision noding uses the **same native grid**, not a new epsilon. This remains
an experimental count-only mesher.

`run.py geometry-optimized` performs cold/warm preparation and bounded real-plan
exports. `batch.py G1` and `batch.py G2` are the only new numerical batches,
each <=512MiB/120s; three short operator timings per configuration. G1 includes
post-fix self controls and the reused positive4D/exact-double-z independent
method. The accepted independent full matrix is reused unchanged.

`audit.py`, `details.py`, `plot.py` consume saved values only. The discrete
vertex-to-boundary Hausdorff comparison uses a segment index; it is an observed
shape comparison, not a certified continuous topology/error enclosure. All
source IDs, symmetric differences, contact classification changes and complete
snapshots remain available. Native tests depend on the minimal five original
tracks/real bridge data in the sibling `copper-geometry` regression JSON files;
those inputs are unchanged and must accompany this packet.

`package-smoke.cjs` verifies the normal default-GPU shared addon ABI and a tiny
five-source geometry request. Placement F32 and C/P6/Thermal APIs are unchanged.
The report distinguishes original failed checkpoints, uncertainty, geometry
runtime tradeoffs, measured coupon gain and unadmitted ROI costs.
